2608.01175.title: The Graph Language: How Knowledge Graphs Speak to Large Language Models
2608.01175.paper_summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at reasoning but benefit from grounding provided by Knowledge Graphs (KGs). However, integrating these paradigms is challenging. We introduce GRALAN, which enables KGs to speak directly in the LLM's semantic space through relational tokens that preserve graph structure. GRALAN-s trainable language mediator generates structured tokens for any frozen LLM, creating a foundation for knowledge-intensive applications. We demonstrate its effectiveness in question-answering by re-framing the task as entity classification over question-focused subgraphs. Experiments show that GRALAN significantly outperforms existing methods, particularly on complex multi-hop reasoning tasks, establishing a new paradigm for KG-LLM integration that maintains structural fidelity while leveraging LLMs' reasoning capabilities.
2608.01175.paper_summary_zh: 大型語言模型（LLMs）在推理方面表現優異，但受益於知識圖譜（KGs）提供的基礎。<lb/>然而，整合這些範式是具有挑戰性的。<lb/>我們介紹了GRALAN，它通過保持圖結構的關聯標記，使KGs能夠直接在LLM的語義空間中進行交流。<lb/>GRALAN的可訓練語言中介為任何凍結的LLM生成結構化標記，為知識密集型應用創造了基礎。<lb/>我們通過將任務重新框定為針對問題聚焦子圖的實體分類，展示了其在問答中的有效性。<lb/>實驗表明，GRALAN顯著超越現有方法，特別是在複雜的多跳推理任務上，建立了一種新的KG-LLM整合範式，保持結構的真實性，同時利用LLMs的推理能力。
